body.description: Abuela Toña, a very old woman: dark purple-grey rebozo shawl over her head and shoulders, long dark dress, a candle in a glass jar in her hands, kind fierce face. a person of a small South Texas border town generations after the sky turned white, sun-faded patched clothes, dust on the boots
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
